title: Coastal Jet CJ-469 cancelled - weather cancellation corroborated by an airport notice

dispute.narrative: My Coastal Jet flight CJ-469 HYD-BLR was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Kavya Iyer
Booking reference (PNR): TACK79
Flight: CJ-469 HYD-BLR departing 16-Sep-2026 17:55 IST
Base fare INR 5,750.00 | Fuel charge INR 1,000.00 | Taxes and fees INR 1,330.00
Total paid INR 8,080.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Kavya, Coastal Jet regrets that flight CJ-469 HYD-BLR scheduled 16-Sep-2026 17:55 IST is cancelled. Sent 16-Sep-2026 09:55 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking TACK79 on CJ-469; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Coastal Jet: I request INR 8,080.00 for the cancellation of CJ-469 (PNR TACK79) on 16 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
